text: Testing plays an important role in software development. Developers write unit tests to check small parts of code, such as a single function, to make sure it works correctly. Integration tests go further by checking how different parts of a system work together. Many teams also use test-driven development, where they write tests before the actual code. This approach helps them think clearly about what the code should do. All of these testing methods give developers more confidence. When tests pass, the team can make changes or add new features without fear, because they know the tests will catch mistakes quickly.
